From: Gerwin Klein <gerwin.klein@proofcraft.systems>

Following Isabelle2026-RC1 which Makarius just announced, the planned fork point for AFP 2026 (for Isabelle2026) is 3 Oct 2026 AoE.

If you have updates planned for afp-devel that should go into the 2026 release, please finish these up by then. Commits after that point will no longer go into afp-2026, but be queued for the Isabelle release after.

Cheers,
Gerwin

From: Gerwin Klein <gerwin.klein@proofcraft.systems>

On 21 Sep 2026, at 05:19, Gerwin Klein <gerwin.klein@proofcraft.systems> wrote:

Following Isabelle2026-RC1 which Makarius just announced, the planned fork point for AFP 2026 (for Isabelle2026) is 3 Oct 2026 AoE.

If you have updates planned for afp-devel that should go into the 2026 release, please finish these up by then. Commits after that point will no longer go into afp-2026, but be queued for the Isabelle release after.

This fork has now happened, and development in afp-devel can continue as usual with respect to the Isabelle development version. New changes in afp-devel will appear in the release after afp-2026.

We can still currently process entries for Isabelle2025-2, but if you have a new entry that can wait until the Isabelle2026 release has happened, please submit it after that.

Cheers,
Gerwin
